_why: The runner field adds a cannot-judge bucket to a gate whose whole job is to fail on a cut wire, so every new branch is a place a real FAIL could hide. M1-M2 are the bucket itself (a playwright pin read as missing again; a renamed one dropped from it). M3-M5 are the dodge: a pytest pin parked as playwright, or an unknown runner, reaching 5f where nothing judges it. M6-M7 are the 5b writer: the field silently not recorded, or a bad record aborting the whole registration batch with a traceback. Review 2026-10-25 added M8-M10: the reader-side check, numbered/conflicting labels, and the template's own spelling. Re-review added M11-M13: runner downgrade at head, read-time full validation, and the template placeholder.

mutations.name: M1: unverifiable split dropped -- every record reaches the pytest partition
mutations._mechanism: A playwright pin can never be collected, so it reads `missing` and the verdict is FAIL by construction -- the defect the field exists to remove.
mutations.find: judgeable = [record for record in head if record_runner(record) in RESOLVED_RUNNERS]

mutations.name: M2: renamed tombstone excluded from the unverifiable bucket
mutations._mechanism: A renamed playwright record is neither judged nor counted, so it vanishes from the token -- a silent PASS rather than a named cannot-judge.

mutations.name: M3: a pytest pin may claim playwright (the non-.py-file rule removed)
mutations._mechanism: A failing .py or bare-name pytest pin re-labelled playwright moves from FAIL to unverifiable -- the dodge the decision rejected option 3 for.

mutations.name: M4: an unknown runner is accepted
mutations._mechanism: `runner: vitest` is not resolved, so it lands in unverifiable -- any typo becomes a free pass at 5f.
mutations.find: if not isinstance(runner, str) or runner not in VALID_RUNNERS:  # M:RUNNER-VALID

mutations.name: M5: validate_record stops consulting runner_problem
mutations._mechanism: register() stops refusing a bad runner: the plan path writes a vitest or bare-name playwright record that only the 5f reader would catch.
mutations.find:
problem = runner_problem(record)
    if problem:
        raise RegistryError(problem)
    return record

mutations.name: M6: the gate does not write WIRE-RUNNER into the record
mutations._mechanism: The plan says playwright, the record says nothing, and 5f reads the pin as a missing pytest test -- the field is decorative.

mutations.name: M7: a bad runner is not skipped at registration
mutations._mechanism: The entry reaches register(), whose RegistryError aborts the whole batch with a traceback and loses every sibling wire.

mutations.name: M8: verify stops validating the records it reads
mutations._mechanism: load() only parses JSON, so a hand-edited .py pin with runner playwright lands in unverifiable and 5f reads PASS.

mutations.name: M9: the gate ignores a numbered or conflicting WIRE-RUNNER
mutations._mechanism: `WIRE-RUNNER 1` or two disagreeing lines register silently under the last value, hiding a mixed-runner task the design cannot express.

mutations.name: M10: the template's parenthetical qualifier is not tolerated
mutations._mechanism: `**WIRE-RUNNER** (optional, ...): playwright` -- the spelling the template prints -- is ignored, so the record is pytest and 5f reads missing.

mutations.name: M11: a judged base record may silently become unverifiable at head
mutations._mechanism: Same identity, pytest at base, playwright at head: the wire stops being judged with no tombstone, and 5f reads PASS.

mutations.name: M12: a runner record read at 5f skips full validation
mutations._mechanism: A playwright record with no pin reads PASS-with-unverifiable, where the same record without a runner crashed loudly.

mutations.name: M13: the template WIRE-RUNNER line carries a real value again
mutations._mechanism: An author who keeps the optional line verbatim gets a pytest task skipped from registration while 5b reads PASS.
mutations.find: `<playwright — only when the pin is not a pytest test>`
mutations.replace: `playwright` when the pin is not a pytest test.

mutations.name: M14: path-qualified parametrized pins fail to resolve against stripped base node ids
mutations._mechanism: Restores the Triage Row 5 defect for path-qualified pins (`hemasuite/tests/test_api.py::test_quit_...`): `pytest --collect-only -q` emits `[case]` suffixes, so skipping `_base_node_id` exact matching leaves the pin missing.

mutations.name: M15: bare parametrized pins fail to resolve when grouped by base node id
mutations._mechanism: Restores the Triage Row 5 defect for suffix-matched pins: a single parametrized test function with k cases is misclassified as ambiguous instead of resolving to its k cases.

mutations.name: M16: subproject-relative pins are not qualified under --rootdir
mutations._mechanism: Restores the 5f nested-rootdir trap: pytest collection roots at `subproject/pytest.ini` and emits `tests/test_wire.py::...`, which `run_pins` then invokes from `--rootdir` where `tests/test_wire.py` does not exist.
